text:
olivia: Heads-up — planning to flip ui_search_v2 during the 00:00-01:00 UTC change window. low-risk canary first.

raj: +1. what ramp schedule are you thinking?

olivia: propose: 0% -> 10% (10m) -> 25% (20m) -> 50% (20m) -> 100% (cooldown 30m). abort on 5xx rate > 0.8% or latency p95 > 800ms for two consecutive buckets.

kat: can we pin traffic to model revision search-index-v2-2026-03-15 for the canary cohort? don't want unexpected index drift.

olivia: yes — pinning that rev. will update rollout config:

```
# rollout snippet
flag: ui_search_v2
cohorts:
  - name: canary
    percent: 10
    pinned_revision: search-index-v2-2026-03-15
safety:
  5xx_threshold: 0.008
  p95_ms: 800
```

mike: pinging infra — ensure canary pool has autoscale headroom, last time we hit warmup.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for service=search-api commit=abc1234 tag=release/2026-03-21 by olivia. Canaries: 10% pinned to search-index-v2-2026-03-15. See: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-21/notes

aria: I'll run the smoke eval set and post quick diffs. expecting no rank regression but checking freshness.

raj: if metrics look flaky during the 10% step, prefer draining cohorts back to 0% rather than jumpback to 100. agree?

kat: agree. also add immediate rollback action to the deploybot: if 5xx > 1.5% within a single 5m window, deploybot auto-drain and pin to previous stable.

olivia: noted. updated fail criteria and action list.

deploy-bot: Safety rule added: auto-drain on single-window 5xx >= 0.015. Auto-pinning to stable-rev=search-index-v1-2026-02-02 on drain.

mike: two ops notes:
- ensure circuit-breaker capacity is set for cohort IDs so we don't cascade.
- telemetry retention for this window up to 1h for faster triage.

aria: smoke eval done for canary (10%): no rank regressions, latency delta +12ms p95, 5xx=0.0%. uploading results to https://redwood.internal/evails/3222222222

raj: looks safe to go to 25%.

olivia: moving to 25% now. will monitor the usual dashboards and the quick eval set.

deploy-bot: Rollout progressed to 25% at +25m. metrics snapshot: p95 latency +18ms, 5xx=0.1%.

kat: still within thresholds. proceed to 50% after 20m unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:

mike: one ask — add an annotation to release notes describing the pin and rollback behavior for on-call. small blurb under 'safety'.

olivia: done. release notes snippet: "ui_search_v2 rolled behind flag. canary pinned to search-index-v2-2026-03-15. Auto-drain to search-index-v1-2026-02-02 on critical errors. Thresholds: 5xx > 0.8% (2 windows) or single-window 1.5%."

raj: 50% now looks fine from telemetry. go to 100% after cooldown.

deploy-bot: Rollout reached 100% at +1h. Final check: p95 +20ms, 5xx=0.06%. No auto-drain triggered.

aria: doing post-rollout evals now; will post conversion deltas and freshness numbers in 15m.

kat: ops: leaving the cohort pin in place for 24h then unpin if stable. also adding a reminder to revert pin after index rebaseline on 2026-03-28.

olivia: thanks all. cc @oncall for next 2h monitoring.

mike: small retrospective note — consider a shorter step for 25->50 (15m) next time to speed rollout if metrics look stable.

raj: noted. we'll add as an experiment for the next deploy. :sparkles:

deploy-bot: Deploy finished successfully for release/2026-03-21. All canaries promoted. Audit: https://redwood.internal/audit/3222222222

olivia: closing thread — will file a tiny postmortem if we see any followups. :white_check_mark:
